pr_title: GameEngine: plan spatial audio, AI, navigation, VFX, and Timeline
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds five proposed ADRs for the next gameplay/editor foundation work:
- spatial audio mixer and authoring UX
- stateful Behavior Tree execution and live debugging
- production multi-level navigation and bake workflow
- extensible VFX assets/runtime and VFX Builder
- Timeline/Sequencer authoring and cross-domain runtime coordination

The ADRs keep Editor, CLI, and MCP semantics on shared authoring services, preserve runtime/authoring separation and Stable IDs, and make Editor responsiveness/live preview/diagnostics part of each design.
